description: This file contains the declaration of a mock class `PersistentStoreImplementationMock` that implements several interfaces related to a persistent storage system, including methods for registration, value management, cache operations, and storage inspection. It uses Google Mock (`gmock`) to facilitate unit testing by mocking these interfaces.

classes.name: PersistentStoreImplementationMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of storage interfaces for testing, implementing registration, key-value operations, cache management, storage inspection, and storage limit features.
